lines.en: I work forward segment by segment.
My body twists as I crawl through soil.

lines.en: Only one segment of me shows.

lines.en: You're standing where I broke through.
I'm right under your soles.

I pulled in a good length of myself.
That crushed one of my segments.
I writhed back into the soil.
Slime splashed off me.

I can grow this back.
My body shuddered.
There's a trace of blood in the soil.

I can't eat that.
Please set it on the muddy ground.
I can't pick out its smell.

I prefer the damp of the soil.
One whiff of this and I'm not hungry.
It's too far from my burrow.
I've no interest in it at all.
That much won't fill me.
Your sole flattens me.

A patch of the ground sank.

This layer of soil holds two of us.

lines.zh: 我们盘在同一块石头下。
lines.en: We coil under the same stone.
You have fewer segments than I do.
Let's wait for footsteps together.
We can press together without parting.

lines.zh: 我们两条盘着同一个洞。
lines.en: The two of us coil in the same burrow.

lines.zh: 土里的震动会告诉我们。
lines.en: The tremors in the soil will tell us.
Two of us are harder to notice.
Burrow slowly; no hurry.
This wet soil belongs to us now.
I met it in the soil.
My teeth won't take it.
I pushed it rolling away.
It's mud from end to end.

lines.zh: 我用身子把它拨进泥里。
lines.en: I nudge it into the mud with my body.
You dropped this on the soil.
I coiled on top of it.
It's wedged in my burrow.

This thing blocks my path.

There's nowhere solid left for you.
I follow along your footprints.
The ground you stepped on is still soft.

lines.zh: 你爬到一块石头上去了。
lines.en: You've scrambled onto a stone.
I'll go around the edge of the stone.
I shorten the distance inch by inch.
Your shadow on the ground moved.
I hear your gasping clearly.
My body is very close now.
I stretch forward a little more.
The soil here is easy to move through.

I can follow you into the water.
The moment you look back, I sink into the soil.
I lunge at your leg.

lines.zh: 我的身体绕住了你的脚。
lines.en: My body coils around your foot.
You staggered from the pull.

I slowly unwind my segments.

The smell in the soil is fresh.

lines.zh: 我的身子被烧得蜷起来。
lines.en: The fire curled me up tight.
I dropped from a height onto the ground.
The water soaked me soft and heavy.
The blast turned the soil over.

lines.zh: 有个东西穿透了我的节。
lines.en: Something pierced right through my segments.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的节发麻。
lines.en: That force numbed my segments.
There's nothing to eat in this soil.
The current came through the mud to me.
No soil below, and no water.
